name: seo-supervisor
description: SEO audit, safe fixes, PR review and a launch gate. Crawls any site, scores it 0-100 and writes a polished offline report.

site_url.title: Site address
site_url.description: Your live site's address, like https://www.example.com. Audits use it when you don't name a site. Leave it empty to have it found from the project.

guard_mode.title: Guard
guard_mode.description: What happens before a risky SEO action, such as a noindex, a robots.txt or redirect change, a removed page or a script that contacts an outside service: ask (pause and ask you, the default), block (stop it, so the AI asks you in chat) or off.
